entradilla.base: As part of the {{empresa}} annual recognition programme, a {{importe}} {{comercio}} voucher has been assigned to you for your {{anios}} years with the company.
entradilla.urgencia: For your {{anios}} years at {{empresa}}, the people team would like to recognise it with a {{importe}} {{comercio}} gift card.
entradilla.urgencia+erratas: We inform you that you have been SELECTED to receive a {{importe}} {{comercio}} gift card for your work at {{empresa}}.

detalle.base: Voucher reference: {{referencia}}. Activation is individual and recorded in the holder's name, so please do not share this link.
detalle.urgencia: The voucher is registered under reference {{referencia}} and linked to your corporate email address.
detalle.urgencia+erratas: This promotion is exclusive for employees and will not be repeated.

urgencia.base: The activation window closes in {{plazo}}. If you cannot make it in time, reply to this email and we will sort it out.
urgencia.urgencia: You have {{plazo}} to activate it. After that, the voucher expires and returns to the general pool.
urgencia.urgencia+erratas: ATTENTION: you must claim it before {{plazo}} or your voucher will be assigned to another colleague.
